rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: EnigmAgent is a secure credential vault that lets AI agents reference secrets using placeholders like {{GITHUB_TOKEN}}, which remain encrypted throughout conversations and logs. Credentials are decrypted locally using AES-256-GCM encryption with Argon2id key derivation only when needed. Includes a browser extension for Chrome, Firefox, Edge, and Brave.
